verses.en: But I determined this with myself, that I would not come again to you in heaviness.
verses.pt: Mas deliberei isto comigo mesmo: não ir mais ter convosco em tristeza.
verses.en_web: But I determined this for myself, that I would not come to you again in sorrow.
verses.en_bbe: But it was my decision for myself, not to come again to you with sorrow.

verses.en: For if I make you sorry, who is he then that maketh me glad, but the same which is made sorry by me?
verses.pt: Porque, se eu vos entristeço, quem é, pois, o que me alegra, senão aquele que por mim é entristecido?
verses.en_web: For if I make you sorry, then who will make me glad but he who is made sorry by me?
verses.en_bbe: For if I give you sorrow, who then will make me glad, but he who is made sad by me?

verses.en: And I wrote this same unto you, lest, when I came, I should have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all, that my joy is the joy of you all.
verses.pt: E escrevi isto mesmo, para que, chegando, eu não tenha tristeza da parte dos que deveriam alegrar-me; confiando em vós todos, que a minha alegria é a de todos vós.
verses.en_web: And I wrote this very thing to you, so that, when I came, I wouldn’t have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all, that my joy would be shared by all of you.
verses.en_bbe: And I said this very thing in my letter, for fear that when I came I might have sorrow from those from whom it was right for me to have joy; being certain of this, that my joy is the joy of you all.

verses.en: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote unto you with many tears; not that ye should be grieved, but that ye might know the love which I have more abundantly unto you.
verses.pt: Porque em muita tribulação e angústia de coração vos escrevi, com muitas lágrimas, não para que vos entristecêsseis, mas para que conhecêsseis o amor que abundantemente vos tenho.
verses.en_web: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote to you with many tears, not that you should be made sorry, but that you might know the love that I have so abundantly for you.
verses.en_bbe: For out of much trouble and pain of heart and much weeping I sent my letter to you; not to give you sorrow, but so that you might see how great is the love which I have to you.

verses.en: But if any have caused grief, he hath not grieved me, but in part: that I may not overcharge you all.
verses.pt: Ora, se alguém tem causado tristeza, não me tem contristado a mim, mas em parte (para não ser por demais severo) a todos vós.
verses.en_web: But if any has caused sorrow, he has caused sorrow, not to me, but in part (that I not press too heavily) to you all.
verses.en_bbe: But if anyone has been a cause of sorrow, he has been so, not to me only, but in some measure to all of you (I say this that I may not be over-hard on you).

verses.en: Sufficient to such a man is this punishment, which was inflicted of many.
verses.pt: Basta a esse tal esta repreensão feita pela maioria.
verses.en_web: This punishment which was inflicted by the many is sufficient for such a one;
verses.en_bbe: Let it be enough for such a man to have undergone the punishment which the church put on him;

verses.en: So that contrariwise ye ought rather to forgive him, and comfort him, lest perhaps such a one should be swallowed up with overmuch sorrow.
verses.pt: De maneira que, pelo contrário, deveis antes perdoar-lhe e consolá-lo, para que ele não seja devorado por excessiva tristeza.
verses.en_web: so that on the contrary you should rather forgive him and comfort him, lest by any means such a one should be swallowed up with his excessive sorrow.
verses.en_bbe: So that now, on the other hand, it is right for him to have forgiveness and comfort from you, for fear that his sorrow may be over-great.

verses.en: Wherefore I beseech you that ye would confirm your love toward him.
verses.pt: Pelo que vos rogo que confirmeis para com ele o vosso amor.
verses.en_web: Therefore I beg you to confirm your love toward him.
verses.en_bbe: For which cause my desire is that you will make your love to him clear by your acts.

verses.en: For to this end also did I write, that I might know the proof of you, whether ye be obedient in all things.
verses.pt: É pois para isso também que escrevi, para, por esta prova, saber se sois obedientes em tudo.
verses.en_web: For to this end I also wrote, that I might know the proof of you, whether you are obedient in all things.
verses.en_bbe: And for the same reason I sent you a letter so that I might be certain of your desire to do my orders in all things.

verses.en: To whom ye forgive any thing, I forgive also: for if I forgave any thing, to whom I forgave it, for your sakes forgave I it in the person of Christ;
verses.pt: E a quem perdoardes alguma coisa, também eu; pois, o que eu também perdoei, se é que alguma coisa tenho perdoado, por causa de vós o fiz na presença de Cristo, para que Satanás não leve vantagem sobre nós;
verses.en_web: Now I also forgive whomever you forgive anything. For if indeed I have forgiven anything, I have forgiven that one for your sakes in the presence of Christ,
verses.en_bbe: But if you give forgiveness to anyone, I do the same: for if I have given forgiveness for anything, I have done it because of you, in the person of Christ;

verses.en: Lest Satan should get an advantage of us: for we are not ignorant of his devices.
verses.pt: porque não ignoramos as suas maquinações.
verses.en_web: that no advantage may be gained over us by Satan; for we are not ignorant of his schemes.
verses.en_bbe: So that Satan may not get the better of us: for we are not without knowledge of his designs.

verses.en: Furthermore, when I came to Troas to preach Christ’s gospel, and a door was opened unto me of the Lord,
verses.pt: Ora, quando cheguei a Trôade para pregar o evangelho de Cristo, e quando se me abriu uma porta no Senhor,
verses.en_web: Now when I came to Troas for the Good News of Christ, and when a door was opened to me in the Lord,
verses.en_bbe: Now when I came to Troas for the good news of Christ, and there was an open door for me in the Lord,

verses.en: I had no rest in my spirit, because I found not Titus my brother: but taking my leave of them, I went from thence into Macedonia.
verses.pt: não tive descanso no meu espírito, porque não achei ali irmão Tito; mas, despedindo-me deles, parti para a Macedônia.
verses.en_web: I had no relief for my spirit, because I didn’t find Titus, my brother, but taking my leave of them, I went out into Macedonia.
verses.en_bbe: I had no rest in my spirit because Titus my brother was not there: so I went away from them, and came into Macedonia.

verses.en: Now thanks be unto God, which always causeth us to triumph in Christ, and maketh manifest the savour of his knowledge by us in every place.
verses.pt: Graças, porém, a Deus que em Cristo sempre nos conduz em triunfo, e por meio de nós difunde em todo lugar o cheiro do seu conhecimento;
verses.en_web: Now thanks be to God, who always leads us in triumph in Christ, and reveals through us the sweet aroma of his knowledge in every place.
verses.en_bbe: But praise be to God who makes us strong to overcome in Christ, and makes clear through us in every place the value of the knowledge of him.

verses.en: For we are unto God a sweet savour of Christ, in them that are saved, and in them that perish:
verses.pt: porque para Deus somos um aroma de Cristo, nos que se salvam e nos que se perdem.
verses.en_web: For we are a sweet aroma of Christ to God, in those who are saved, and in those who perish;
verses.en_bbe: For we are a sweet perfume of Christ to God in those who are getting salvation and in those who are going to destruction;

verses.en: To the one we are the savour of death unto death; and to the other the savour of life unto life. And who is sufficient for these things?
verses.pt: Para uns, na verdade, cheiro de morte para morte; mas para outros cheiro de vida para vida. E para estas coisas quem é idôneo?
verses.en_web: to the one a stench from death to death; to the other a sweet aroma from life to life. Who is sufficient for these things?
verses.en_bbe: To the one it is a perfume of death to death; to the other a perfume of life to life. And who is enough for such things?

verses.en: For we are not as many, which corrupt the word of God: but as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God speak we in Christ.
verses.pt: Porque nós não somos falsificadores da palavra de Deus, como tantos outros; mas é com sinceridade, é da parte de Deus e na presença do próprio Deus que, em Cristo, falamos.
verses.en_web: For we are not as so many, peddling the word of God. But as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God, we speak in Christ.
verses.en_bbe: For we are not like the great number who make use of the word of God for profit: but our words are true, as from God, being said as before God in Christ.
